why: Passes any ?shellTrail= value through unvalidated. The renderer builds the trail only for 'segments', so a typo would reach it as a truthy unknown style and silently draw nothing while the Developer panel reported the flag as set -- the flag-that-does-nothing failure the gallery refusals were written against.
